text: An impl in a library's impl file for a type from its api file passed the library rule, but other libraries never see it; an impl in a generic scope was visible outside but unusable since its generic bindings could not be specified. Now the type structure needs an anchor name whose first owning declaration is in the same file, in the scope containing the impl or a nested scope (proposals/p007140-orphan-rule-for-scopes.md).
